note: Everything that has wings, whether or not it uses them: `altitude` is the difference between a bird in the sky and a bird standing in a field. Fields are as described in beasts.json.

chicken.note: One hit point, so it is the first thing most heroes ever kill, and the reason meat is never scarce near a village.
chicken.label: Chicken

duck.note: Slower than anything else with wings, because it spends its life on water rather than above it.
duck.label: Duck

vulture.note: It circles rather than hunts: `timid` is false and `dangerous` absent, so it comes to look at you and nothing more. What it is worth is what it has already picked over.
vulture.label: Vulture

heron.note: The slowest creature in the world, standing still in the reeds on purpose. Nothing about it is a threat and nothing about it runs.
heron.label: Heron

eagle.note: Higher than the vulture and quicker, which is the whole difference between them: one waits for a thing to die and the other is the reason it did.
eagle.label: Eagle
